QuestInfo.name: Power of the Spirit of Lightning
QuestInfo.0: Following what the Empress said, go see #bChief Knight Hawkeye#k before leaving Ereve.
QuestInfo.1: To use Hawkeye's Shark Wave, you need a catalyst that will maximize the power of the Spirit of Lightning. Get it from #r#o4230201##k.
QuestInfo.2: You've learned Hawkeye's Shark Wave skill. Use Earth-Cleaving Lightning every 5 Levels to raise the Skill Level by 1 until Lv. 90.

0.0: Hey! Hey you! All right, an Explorer at Ereve! Aren't you #b#h0##k, the Explorer the Empress was talking about? That's means you're totally interested in my awesome Shark Wave?

yes.0: That's what I thought! Shark Wave combines the power of the Spirit of Lighting with a mighty shark, and launches it at enemies. For such power, you need Earth-Cleaving Lightning. That's the only thing that can hold the power of the Spirit of Lightning.
yes.1: If you bring me #b10 #t4032883#s#k items, from #r#o4230201#s#k monsters, I'll teach you Shark Wave.

no.0: What, don't you think it's awesome? It's an ELECTRIC SHARK! Come ON!

1.0: Oh yeah, that's the power of the Spirit of Lightning! Give them to me, and zappy sharks are yours.

yes.0: Check the Beginner's Basics tab by opening your Skill Inventory. Now you can use my power to summon the Shark Wave.
yes.1: And remember that you can come every 5 Levels to raise the Skill Level by 1 until Lv. 90.

item.0: You can't learn Shark Wave without #b10 #t4032883##k items. You can get them from #r#o4230201##k.
